close You can book up to nine passengers only, including adults, children, and infants. Each adult is allowed to travel with only one infant. For children traveling alone, please contact us. Unaccompanied minors have to pay the full adult fare.

Flight Schedule: Riyadh – Tokyo operates every Tuesday, Thursday, and Saturday.

From the moment you arrive, Tokyo pulls you into its rhythm. Bright city lights, hidden green spaces, immersive experiences, and unforgettable flavors create a destination full of surprises. Fly with Saudia and discover Japan's vibrant capital.

Experience the energy of Shibuya Crossing, one of the world's busiest intersections.

Then enjoy spectacular views from Tokyo Skytree.

Step into the immersive world of teamLab Planets, where digital art transforms every visit into a one-of-a-kind experience.

Spend a quiet moment in the beautiful Shinjuku Gyoen National Garden, a peaceful space in the heart of the city.

From fresh sushi and premium wagyu beef to authentic tempura and handcrafted Japanese desserts, Tokyo's culinary scene is as exciting as the city itself.

Fly to Tokyo with Saudia and discover a destination where every moment brings something new.
